title: Pointwise invertibility of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T and a prime ell invertible on T, and n,d natural numbers, any morphism f from realization T ell n of finiteSheaf T ell n d to quotientLine T ell n d satisfying GeneratorCompatible induces an isomorphism on every pro-etale section.

source.place: Step 2: local rank-one argument in the ordinary quotient comparison

proof.text: Choose the common pro-etale covering with compatible primitive roots. Scalar coordinates identify the inverse-limit root line and its finite quotient with rank-one coordinate modules. GeneratorCompatible identifies the section map with the identity in these coordinates, hence the section morphism is invertible; restriction compatibility handles every pro-etale section.

proof_origin.place: Step 2: local rank-one argument in the ordinary quotient comparison

mathlib_searches.results: The sheaf local isomorphism criterion and preservation of isomorphisms by the forgetful functor are used in the reduction.
